jyutping: fong3 dai1 sam1 tau4 daai6 sek6

english.note: Use this when a major worry or problem has finally been resolved and the burden is lifted.

examples.english: Now that my visa has been approved, I can finally feel relieved.
examples.traditional: 簽證批咗，我終於可以放低心頭大石喇。
